about: Research sheet for the Montana county edition. Every contact below was read on the date in reviewed_on from the page named beside it; scripts/make_county_state.py turns it into the edition files.
name: Montana
phones_sentence: Veterans office phones come from the Veterans Affairs Division’s Veteran Services page. Counties without an office show the division’s statewide line and all nine office phones.

offices.source_title: Montana Veterans Affairs Division: Veteran Services
offices.note: Veteran Service Officers help with VA claims, pension, survivor benefits and appeals at no charge.
offices.selection: Montana has no county veterans offices; the Veterans Affairs Division has nine service offices. Phones come from the division’s Veteran Services page (read in full), street addresses from its office contact sheet (https://dma.mt.gov/MVAD/MVAD-Documents/MVAD-Office-Contacts.pdf; read in full) and Butte’s hours from its office page. No current official page says which counties each office serves, so the nine counties that hold an office show it, and the other 47 show the division’s statewide line with every office phone.

list.address: 1956 Mt. Majo Street, PO Box 4789, Fort Harrison, MT 59636-4789
list.note: No veteran service office is in this county. Call the division or the nearest of its nine offices: Belgrade 406-388-4601; Billings 406-248-8579; Butte 406-533-0910; Great Falls 406-452-2265; Havre 406-265-4225; Helena 406-324-4774; Kalispell 406-755-3795; Miles City 406-232-1203; Missoula 406-542-2501. Service officers also hold outreach in more than 47 communities.

aging.source_title: Montana DPHHS: Aging and Disability Resource Centers
aging.source_scope: Each Area Agency on Aging ADRC with its city, phone and the counties it serves; read in full; undated. Phones and addresses were checked against the Area Agency on Aging contact list (https://prod-dphhs.mt.gov/assets/sltc/AAA/AAAContacts.pdf; read in full; updated August 2026), which gives the statewide line, 1-800-551-3191. Area III is not on the ADRC page; see its card.
aging.next_step_extra: The statewide line, 1-800-551-3191, also rings your local Area Agency on Aging.

regions.label: I
regions.name: Action for Eastern Montana, Area I Agency on Aging (Glendive)
notes: The state’s ADRC page lists the Fort Peck Reservation for Area I; the state ombudsman directory names Roosevelt County with Area I.

regions.label: II
regions.name: Area II Agency on Aging (Roundup)
notes: Yellowstone County: The Alliance Resource Center of Yellowstone County, 406-259-5212. Area II also serves the Crow and Northern Cheyenne reservations.

regions.label: III

programs.name: Montana veterans: Veterans Affairs Division service officers for claims help
programs.organization: Montana Department of Military Affairs, Veterans Affairs Division (MVAD)
programs.description: Free help from MVAD’s accredited Veteran Service Officers: VA compensation and pension claims, appeals and hearings, survivor claims, military records and referrals, from nine offices and outreach visits across Montana.
programs.next_step: Call the nearest office (choose a county above) or the division at 406-324-3742.
constraints: Service officers travel for outreach; call ahead for times and places.

programs.name: Montana Area Agencies on Aging and Aging and Disability Resource Centers
programs.organization: Montana DPHHS Office on Aging and the Area Agencies on Aging
programs.description: Montana’s Area Agencies on Aging, most also Aging and Disability Resource Centers, give information, options counseling and help with in-home services, meals, caregiver support and benefits. One toll-free line rings the local agency. Military service is not required.
programs.next_step: Call 1-800-551-3191, or choose a county above for its Area Agency on Aging.
constraints: Each program has its own eligibility and waitlist.

programs.name: Medicare counseling (Montana SHIP)
programs.organization: Montana DPHHS Office on Aging, State Health Insurance Assistance Program (SHIP), through the Area Agencies on Aging
programs.description: Free, confidential health-benefits counseling for Medicare beneficiaries and their families from SHIP counselors at the Area Agencies on Aging.
programs.next_step: Call 1-800-551-3191; staff refer you to the SHIP counselor at your county’s Area Agency on Aging. For Medicare itself, call 800-MEDICARE (800-633-4227).
constraints: Counseling is by appointment. Have your Medicare card and drug list ready.

sources.title: Montana DPHHS: State Health Insurance Assistance Program
sources.scope: No-cost Medicare counseling; call 1-800-551-3191 to be referred to the local Area Agency on Aging’s SHIP counselor; search excerpt.

programs.name: Montana Long-Term Care Ombudsman and adult abuse reporting
programs.organization: Montana DPHHS: Long-Term Care Ombudsman Program; Adult Protective Services
programs.description: Advocacy for residents of nursing homes, assisted living and other long-term care settings, through regional ombudsmen and the State Long-Term Care Ombudsman. Adult Protective Services takes reports of abuse, neglect or exploitation of people 60 and older and adults with disabilities.
programs.next_step: Choose a county above for its ombudsman, or call the State Long-Term Care Ombudsman at 406-444-3285. To report abuse, call Adult Protective Services at 1-844-277-9300 (weekdays 8 a.m. to 5 p.m.) or report online any time at aps.mt.gov. In an emergency, call 911.
constraints: The ombudsman acts with the resident’s permission and is not a licensing agency.

programs.name: Free legal help for older Montanans
programs.organization: Montana Legal Services Association; DPHHS Office on Aging, Legal Services Developer
programs.description: Montana Legal Services Association gives free civil legal help to people with low incomes statewide. The Legal Services Developer in the state Office on Aging provides elder law resources, legal referrals and basic help with legal documents.
programs.next_step: Apply online at mtlsa.org or call the MLSA HelpLine at 1-800-666-6899 (Tuesday to Thursday, 9 a.m. to 1 p.m.). For elder law help, call the Office on Aging’s Legal Services Developer at 800-332-2272.
constraints: Legal aid screens by income and case type; HelpLine hours are limited, so keep trying or apply online.

programs.name: VA health care in Montana
programs.organization: U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs, VA Montana Health Care System
programs.description: Montana veterans are served by the VA Montana Health Care System: the Fort Harrison VA Medical Center (3687 Veterans Drive, Fort Harrison; 406-442-6410, toll-free 877-468-8387) and clinics across the state.
programs.next_step: Call 877-468-8387 or 406-442-6410 for appointments. Not enrolled yet? Ask a Veteran Service Officer for help applying.
constraints: If a service you need is not offered near you, ask about travel benefits and community care.
